exams.name: ARE 5.0 Practice Management (PcM)
exams.body: National Council of Architectural Registration Boards (NCARB)
exams.blurb: ARE 5.0 division testing financial, legal and operational management of an architecture practice.

exams.name: ARE 5.0 Programming & Analysis (PA)
exams.body: National Council of Architectural Registration Boards (NCARB)
exams.blurb: ARE 5.0 division testing programming, site analysis and code research for architectural projects.

exams.name: ARE 5.0 Project Development & Documentation (PDD)
exams.body: National Council of Architectural Registration Boards (NCARB)
exams.blurb: ARE 5.0 division testing detailed design, documentation and building code compliance.

exams.name: ARE 5.0 Project Management (PjM)
exams.body: National Council of Architectural Registration Boards (NCARB)
exams.blurb: ARE 5.0 division testing project delivery, contracts and team coordination for architects.

exams.name: ARE 5.0 Project Planning & Design (PPD)
exams.body: National Council of Architectural Registration Boards (NCARB)
exams.blurb: ARE 5.0 division testing schematic design and preliminary integration of building systems.

exams.name: NCARB Certificate
exams.body: National Council of Architectural Registration Boards (NCARB)
exams.blurb: Credential enabling architects to license across jurisdictions via reciprocal registration agreements.

exams.name: LEED AP Building Design + Construction
exams.blurb: Specialist credential for professionals leading LEED certification in new building design and construction.

exams.name: LEED AP Homes
exams.blurb: Specialist credential for professionals on LEED certification of single- and multifamily homes.

exams.name: LEED AP Interior Design + Construction
exams.blurb: Specialist credential for professionals on LEED certification of commercial interior fit-outs.

exams.name: LEED AP Neighborhood Development
exams.blurb: Specialist credential for professionals on LEED certification of neighborhood-scale development.

exams.name: LEED AP Operations + Maintenance
exams.blurb: Specialist credential for professionals improving operations of existing buildings via LEED O+M.

exams.name: LEED Green Associate
exams.blurb: Entry credential demonstrating general knowledge of green building and the LEED rating system.

exams.name: SME Certified Machine Tool Sales Engineer (CMTSE)
exams.blurb: Credential for sales engineers of machine tools covering product and application knowledge.

exams.name: SME Certified Manufacturing Engineer (CMfgE)
exams.blurb: Senior credential for manufacturing engineers covering process engineering and systems design.

exams.name: SME Certified Manufacturing Technologist (CMfgT)
exams.blurb: Mid-level credential covering manufacturing processes, materials, quality and production technology.

exams.name: SME Lean Certification Bronze
exams.blurb: Entry lean credential covering waste identification and core lean tools in operations.

exams.name: SME Lean Certification Gold
exams.blurb: Senior lean credential covering enterprise lean strategy and culture transformation.

exams.name: SME Lean Certification Silver
exams.blurb: Intermediate lean credential covering value-stream improvement and lean deployment leadership.

exams.name: ICC Concrete Special Inspector
exams.blurb: Certifies special inspection of concrete placement, reinforcement and strength testing per the IBC.

exams.name: ICC Masonry Special Inspector
exams.blurb: Certifies special inspection of masonry construction including reinforcement and grout placement.

exams.name: ICC Reinforced Concrete Special Inspector
exams.blurb: Certifies advanced inspection of reinforced concrete including post-tensioning and prestressed members.

exams.name: ICC Steel Special Inspector
exams.blurb: Certifies special inspection of structural steel erection, bolting and welding per the IBC.

exams.name: ICC Structural Welding Special Inspector
exams.blurb: Certifies inspection of structural welding and bonded connectors per AWS and IBC requirements.

exams.name: ICC Wood Special Inspector
exams.blurb: Certifies special inspection of wood construction including fastening and engineered lumber systems.

exams.name: NSPS Certified Federal Surveyor (CFedS)
exams.blurb: Certifies surveyors to perform boundary surveys on federally owned and tribal trust lands.

exams.name: NSPS Certified Survey Technician Level I
exams.blurb: Entry certification for surveying technicians covering math, field and office surveying fundamentals.

exams.name: NSPS Certified Survey Technician Level II
exams.blurb: Intermediate certification covering boundary, construction and GPS surveying technician skills.

exams.name: NSPS Certified Survey Technician Level III
exams.blurb: Advanced certification covering complex boundary, control and photogrammetry technician work.

exams.name: NSPS Certified Survey Technician Level IV
exams.blurb: Senior certification covering survey project management and expert technician responsibilities.

exams.name: ASCM CLTD (Certified in Logistics, Transportation and Distribution)
exams.blurb: Credential covering logistics, transportation and distribution network management.

exams.name: ASCM CPIM (Certified in Planning and Inventory Management)
exams.blurb: Credential covering production planning, scheduling and inventory management fundamentals.

exams.name: ASCM CSCP (Certified Supply Chain Professional)
exams.blurb: Credential covering end-to-end supply chain design, planning and execution.

exams.name: ASCM CTSC (Certified in Transformation for Supply Chain)
exams.blurb: Credential covering supply chain strategy, digital transformation and process redesign.

exams.name: ISA Certified Automation Professional (CAP)
exams.blurb: Credential for engineers designing and deploying enterprise automation and control systems.

exams.name: ISA Certified Control Systems Technician (CCST) Level I
exams.blurb: Entry credential for technicians calibrating and maintaining instrumentation and controls.

exams.name: ISA Certified Control Systems Technician (CCST) Level II
exams.blurb: Intermediate credential for technicians troubleshooting and documenting control systems.

exams.name: ISA Certified Control Systems Technician (CCST) Level III
exams.blurb: Senior credential for technicians leading control systems work and mentoring others.
